hero.title: Guitar tabs
hero.description: Accurate arrangements of popular songs as guitar tabs. Buy, download and play — it's that simple.

about.text1: I'm a guitarist and arranger: I create complete solo guitar arrangements of popular songs and turn them into detailed, easy-to-follow tabs.
about.detail1Text: I work through every song manually, preserving its recognizable melody, bass line and harmony.
about.detail2Text: I choose practical fingerings and perform every arrangement myself before publishing it.
about.detail3Text: Each tab includes a difficulty level and useful files for learning the arrangement comfortably.
about.detail4Text: Paid arrangements include a preview so you can check the layout and readability of the tabs in advance.
